The left column features four circular lenses (top red illuminated, followed by three unlit blue-tinted or dark lenses). The right column features three circular lenses (top red/orange illuminated, middle red illuminated, bottom unlit blue-tinted lens). The housing is gray metal with visors over each lens. The background shows a street scene with parked cars (a blue van and a silver sedan) and a building facade, rendered with a painterly, textured aesthetic.
